title: I-35 Multi-semi pile up (Feb 22, 2022)
description: At one point, we referred to this as I-35W out of habit. We regret the error.

transcript.text: Big snowstorm today in the Twin Cities. We're only a few hours into the snow event, but we've already got one rollover on camera seen here and a pile up on I-35 involving multiple semi-trucks. Good news, injuries on this rollover are not believed to be life-threatening. Next, on to the pile-up. The original pile-up occurs off camera, but you've got a school bus there moving off to the side of the road wisely getting out of the way. More traffic coming into the scene, and we've got traffic at a full stop. Blocking a lot of the traffic is that jackknife semi. It's too early to say with specifics what exactly happened here. But even further down, I-35W, same camera view. Looks like there's some other vehicles, maybe in a crash or off-road. Twin Cities is supposed to get five to six inches of snow in the metro area, depending on where you are. And some heavy snow bounds are creating these kind of white-out conditions. For scale, on the left side of the screen, you can see a pedestrian out. Things have kind of settled down there. Getting a closer look, you can see that red tanker getting squeezed between two semi-trucks, a dangerous situation, and a sedan that's caught a little bit underneath one of the semi-trucks that's called Underride. Thankfully, State Patrol reports no serious injuries with this crash incredibly. Some great news there. We will have more updates on this storm. Make sure to like, subscribe, share this stuff. Turn on those notifications. We will definitely have a snowstorm recap in the next 24 hours. You won't want to miss it.
